bosscue.wintercrag: Freezes the frontline — spread your ultimates
bosscue.magmourn: Hurls fire at the back row — move your caster
bosscue.voraxis: Hits harder as it loses health
bosscue.grommash: Heavy cleaves — keep your Tank in front
bosscue.leviath: Drenches the field — sustained damage wins
bosscue.ch1: {boss} drops the anvil on your tank and chains a hero back to him — stun-break, then burst
bosscue.ch2: {boss} charges through the line and gores whoever he lands on — keep the tank square in front
bosscue.ch3: {boss} freezes whoever stands closest and stops a heart in your backline — spread out, keep a cleanse
bosscue.ch4: {boss}'s undertow hits everyone near the front and her sentence stuns one — sustain and cleanse
bosscue.ch5: {boss} hushes your casters and fires five shots at once — kill her before the second volley
bosscue.ch6: {boss} burns everything beside him and locks your line in cinder — only the tank in reach
bosscue.ch7: {boss} claws in threes and drops a cyclone that slows the field — do not stand still in it
bosscue.ch8: {boss} charges and hurls three glass axes down the line — spread out, he cannot be moved
bosscue.ch9: {boss}'s broadside pierces the whole line and his anchor drags a hero in — burst him early
bosscue.ch10: {boss} breathes a burning grave-cone and rushes the line with a stunning charge — spread out, keep the tank in front
bosscue.ch11: {boss} throws a lance down the whole line and hides behind a shard guard — save your burst for when it drops
bosscue.ch12: {boss}'s pollen slows and poisons the field and she heals herself — step out of the cloud and bring burst
bosscue.ch13: {boss} sweeps a half-circle cleave in front of him and locks one hero in place for two seconds, and every few seconds he cleanses an ally of its controls — spread out of the cleave and burst him while the lock is down
bosscue.ch14: {boss} sets the ground alight with wildfire roots, then collapses it to stun — spread out and keep a cleanse
bosscue.ch15: {boss} hurls fireballs into your group and sets every hero burning at once — spread out and bring healing
bosscue.ch16: {boss} rains meteors on four heroes and eclipses one — bring healing, then a burst for the finish
bosscue.default: A stage guardian — bring your ultimates ready
